activation_condition: Both source-bound candidate trajectories finish e200 and the authoritative 4090 cross-version adjudication reports that neither passes the registered numeric gate.
automatic_actions_after_activation: measure BVCP rollout-speed constraint reduction at its unchanged source-bound e200 checkpoint
measure fixed-state per-player conditional native-gradient variance reduction for PC-RSMG at its unchanged source-bound e200 checkpoint
require a material PC-RSMG variance ratio below 0.8 rather than treating sampling noise below 1.0 as causal evidence
aggregate source-bound trajectory and algorithm fingerprints without importing sibling candidate code
route at most one evidence-supported parent to manual mathematical derivation
scientific_limit: The PC-RSMG audit is a target-blind fixed-state per-player conditional-variance proxy. It is not represented as proof that the complete finite-step sequential game has been corrected.
positive_cross_version_behavior: Exit as inapplicable; the positive winner seed and ablation successors retain authority.
forbidden_automatic_actions: derive or train a revision without a new derivation card and gates
change replica count or tune a fixed intervention window
read paired metrics for training control
